slug: 电竞世界冠军选秀c位出道

第(1/3)页

一路上，他小心避开雨洼，沿着路灯走。

不远处就是亮着光的小区保安岗亭，看到熟悉的出入口，江执屿不免微微松了口气。

他随意地将握在手中的双肩包往左肩上一搭，抬脚继续向前走着。

突然，眼角余光扫到巷口一道黑影飞快一闪，他下意识转头细看，巷子里却安安静静，半个人影都寻不见。

江执屿眉头轻轻皱起，心里多了几分戒备，打算尽快离开，脚步刚动，一道身影跌跌撞撞从暗处冲出来，直直撞在他身上。

“唔……”

冲击力不小，江执屿身子猛地往侧边歪了一下，险些直接摔进路边积水里。

他抬手捂住肩膀，望向撞过来的男人。

对方脸色惨白，满脸虚汗，眼神涣散，左手死死捂着小腹，右手紧紧攥着一个漆黑的包裹。

隐约可见对方捂着腹部的指缝间不断外渗着暗色液体，全都被他缠在掌心的毛巾吸走，那块毛巾早已浸透一大片刺目的暗红。

“不好意思……”

男人费力抬头看了一眼江执屿，道歉的声音很虚弱，小到几乎弱不可闻。

“没事。”江执屿摇了摇头，弯腰捡起摔落在积水边的双肩包，拍了拍包面沾到的水渍。

一旁的巷口里传来隐约的脚步声，男人脸色骤然一变，看似无意地抬手拍了下江执屿的背包，没再多说半个字，转瞬消失在黑夜里。

没过几秒，巷子里便走出了一个穿着低调工装服的男人，单手插兜，嘴角带着笑。

这两个字瞬间涌上心头。

江执屿抿住嘴，嗅到这人身上飘来的浓浓血腥味，几欲作呕。

但他没有表现出任何反常，只是面不改色地继续向前走着。

二人擦肩而过时，浑身上下写着“危险”的男人侧头搭话，语气漫不经心：“小孩，你看见刚刚那个男的往哪个方向跑了吗？”

江执屿眸光一闪，脸上依旧是茫然无害的模样，随口答道：“啊？没留意，什么男人？我刚一直低头走路，没看清。”

男人嘴角保持着上扬的幅度，眯起眼睛直直盯着江执屿的脸。

“江江？”

Along the way, he carefully avoided rain puddles and walked along the street lights.

Not far away was the illuminated community security guard box. Seeing the familiar entrance and exit, Jiang Zhiyu couldn't help but breathed a sigh of relief.

He casually put the backpack in his hand on his left shoulder, lifted his feet and continued walking forward.

Suddenly, out of the corner of his eye, he saw a dark shadow flashing quickly at the entrance of the alley. He subconsciously turned his head to take a closer look, but the alley was quiet, and no one could be found.

Jiang Zhiyu frowned slightly, feeling more wary and planning to leave as soon as possible. As soon as he moved, a figure stumbled out of the darkness and bumped into him.

"Well..."

The impact was so strong that Jiang Zhiyu's body suddenly tilted to the side, and he almost fell directly into the water on the roadside.

He raised his hands to cover his shoulders and looked at the man who bumped into him.

The other party's face was pale, his face was covered with sweat, his eyes were distracted, his left hand was tightly covering his lower abdomen, and his right hand was tightly holding a dark package.

It was vaguely visible that dark liquid was seeping out between the fingers of the other person covering his abdomen, all of which was absorbed by the towel wrapped in his palm. The towel had already been soaked in a large area of ​​dazzling dark red.

"Sorry..."

The man raised his head with effort and glanced at Jiang Zhiyu. His apology voice was very weak, so small that it was almost inaudible.

"It's okay." Jiang Zhiyu shook his head, bent down to pick up the backpack that had fallen by the water, and patted the water stains on the surface of the bag.

Faint footsteps came from the alley nearby, and the man's expression suddenly changed. He raised his hand and patted Jiang Zhiyu's backpack seemingly unintentionally. Without saying another word, he disappeared into the dark night.

Within a few seconds, a man wearing low-key overalls walked out of the alley, with one hand in his pocket and a smile on his face.

These two words came to mind instantly.

Jiang Zhiyu pursed his lips and almost felt sick when he smelled the strong smell of blood coming from this man.

But he didn't show any abnormality and just continued to walk forward without changing his expression.

When the two passed by, the man with "Danger" written all over his body turned to talk to him in a casual tone: "Child, did you see which direction that man ran just now?"

Jiang Zhiyu's eyes flashed, but his face remained blank and harmless, and he replied casually: "Huh? I didn't pay attention. What kind of man? I just kept walking with my head down, so I didn't see clearly."

The corners of the man's mouth kept rising, and he narrowed his eyes and stared directly at Jiang Zhiyu's face.

"Jiang Jiang?"
